basic_info.description: Video Preview! On the Top of Pacific Heights, less than 300' from the marquee corner of Lafayette Park and 2.5 blocks to Fillmore is a rare opportunity. 2443 & 2445 Washington are two remodeled condominiums in a 2 unit building, each with exquisite exclusive outdoor living spaces offered separately... simultaneously. Intuitively designed & well built in 1948, the shared entry courtyard leads to the 2 front doors in the center of the floor plates. 2443 Washington is the lower 2 bedroom 2 bathroom home. From the entry hall with a coat closet, the living room with fireplace looks north to Washington Street & leads to the dining room connected with the open remodeled kitchen. A full bath is between the living area & bedrooms. The east bedroom, & the primary suite, both open to the large exclusive southern facing deck & shared beautiful terraced & landscaped yard. The condominium has a large storage room, laundry area & 1 car parking.
